findings.title: uv run pytest gate exited 1 on an unrelated runner test
findings.evidence: 05-gate.txt lines 92-94, 102-103: test_an_unwritable_worktree_parent_is_refused 'DID NOT RAISE Refused'; chmod 0o500 expectation fails, probably because the runner ran as root; the test file is untouched by this diff
findings.consequence: The manifest reports result: failed, though the phase diff does not touch the failing test
findings.minimal_fix: Confirm the failure on the base commit or as non-root; optionally skip the test when euid == 0 (outside this phase)

findings.title: No test pins route-side markdown/image rendering or the CSP sandbox header that R01 parity and R02 depend on
findings.evidence: HtmlViewerRegion.doubleClick.test.tsx stubs fetch and window.open and only checks the URL passed; the header is set at ts/vite.config.ts:264 and verified here only by reading
findings.consequence: A later route change could break new-tab rendering or sandboxing without failing these tests
findings.minimal_fix: Add a route-level test or record a manual browser check; optional for this phase

findings.title: fileHref does not URL-encode the path
findings.evidence: HtmlViewerRegion.tsx fileHref returns WORKBENCH_FILE_PREFIX + path; same as the existing openTabHref link
findings.consequence: A file name containing # or ? opens the wrong URL; no regression since the existing link behaves the same
findings.minimal_fix: Encode each path segment in fileHref

notes: Shadow judge (gating: false), same brief as the gating reviewer plus the runner manifest; no checkout. Its F02 and F03 are carried as ideas (the Playwright check the builder ran is in the session record; the path-encoding gap is shared with the existing link). Evidence file is the judge's final message transcribed by the coordinator (the judge has no write tool); findings and JSON verbatim, narrative condensed.
